work_title: Return strict Seq/Vector from mempool readers instead of lazy Stream (#1551)
description: Completed in https://github.com/ergoplatform/ergo/pull/2941 (targeting v6.0.11): replaced lazy Stream collections returned from ErgoMemPoolReader, OrderedTxPool, and ErgoMemPool with strict Seq/Vector, removed redundant .toSeq conversions in CleanupWorker and CandidateGenerator, and updated ErgoReadersHolderSpec.
